## HOW TO USE THIS FILE: Layout example only. Installation fills wallet address, contract addresses and network parameters. The 100 GiB allocation here is an example, not an installation default. Do not copy this file over an installed configuration.
## NODE IDENTITY DO NOT CHANGE: The public wallet address must match the encrypted wallet. Private keys are stored separately, not in this config.
## STORAGE ALLOCATION: storage_capacity_bytes is the capacity this node provides. Set during installation; keep extra disk space for proofs, downloads and logs. Changing this value does not move or delete stored data.
## NETWORK AND DISCOVERY: RPC and network configuration endpoints, public TCP port and discovery services. Automatic address discovery checks public reachability.
## STORAGE FEES AND STAKE: storage_fee is SU per GB per day. stake_wei is the registration stake in wei. Review network requirements before registration.
## TRANSFER LIMITS: Upload/download concurrency, queue limits and partial-upload retention. Defaults limit resource use; raise only with sufficient resources.
## QUOTE LIMITS: Limits and timing for reserved capacity and transfer quotes.
## SECTOR POLICY: Local sector packing, lifetime and expiration extension policy.
## CAPACITY PROOF SCHEDULING: Batch timing and pending-mutation thresholds. These tune scheduling, not the network proof requirements.
## PROOF WORKERS AND TIMEOUTS: Worker maximum 0 uses available CPUs. startup_timeout_sec 0 waits for server startup without a fixed cutoff. Native capacity progress reports readiness to accept pieces separately. Prover nice is 0–19; I/O priority is low or normal.
## LOG FILES: Log rotation limits. log_eth_calls enables detailed chain-read logging and may produce large logs. transaction_log_path must stay inside the node state directory.
## NETWORK PROOF PARAMETERS DO NOT CHAN: These values come from the approved signed deployment and proof bundles. Changing them arbitrarily stops startup.
## CONTRACT ADDRESSES DO NOT CHANGE: Active contract addresses must match the approved signed network deployment.
## CONTRACT DESCRIPTION FILES DO NOT CH: Paths to contract ABI JSON files. The node reads these files and checks their ABIs against the signed deployment.
